purpose: Pre-register the evidence needed to validate Pineland's latent local-control and armed-presence states without silently converting narrative claims into numeric labels.
measurement_rule: A control/presence value is admissible only when source, date or interval, geography, actor, observable definition, extraction rule, and uncertainty are recorded. Missing evidence remains null.

sources.title: Nepal Conflict Report 2012
sources.publisher: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights
sources.blocking_reason: Requires source-level manual coding and uncertainty adjudication before any numeric panel is created.

sources.title: INSEC human-rights incident report (complete report)
sources.blocking_reason: Does not independently identify a dated, actor-specific territorial-control state.

coding_template.uncertainty_policy: Narrative, conflicting, or geographically ambiguous claims are retained with uncertainty labels and are not used as calibration targets until independently adjudicated.

planned_validation.geographic_unit: district-week where source resolution permits; otherwise interval-censored district evidence
planned_validation.comparison: Compare recorded historical evidence to synthetic recorded history and compare latent control only where an independently coded observable exists.
planned_validation.holdouts: Preserve the frozen temporal, geographic, and strict joint holdouts from split_manifest.json.
planned_validation.calibration: No control/presence parameters are calibrated in the current benchmark.
